title: Rating Day of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental First-Day Fee
content:
**Rating-day ruling.** The rating day of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental first-day fee — the day whose weekday the fee is rated at — is chosen by the booking. The booked days are the calendar days from the scheduled pickup date to the scheduled return date, each counted from the scheduled pickup date onward: a booking of three days takes in the scheduled pickup date and the two calendar days after it.

1. A contract booked for **3** or more days is rated as the busiest of its booked days: a booking that takes in a Saturday or a Sunday is rated as a Saturday, and otherwise one that takes in a Friday is rated as a Friday; a booking that takes in none of those days is rated on its scheduled pickup date.
2. A contract booked for fewer days whose scheduled pickup time is 17:00 or later is rated on the day after its scheduled pickup date, since an evening rental is used through the next day.
3. Any other contract is rated on its scheduled pickup date.

## Calendar examples (hypothetical bookings)

| Scheduled pickup | Scheduled return | Booked days and the days taken in | Rating day |
|---|---|---|---|
| Thursday 10:00 | Sunday | 3: Thursday, Friday, Saturday | Saturday |
| Sunday 10:00 | Wednesday | 3: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday | Saturday — a Sunday is taken in |
| Wednesday 10:00 | Saturday | 3: Wednesday, Thursday, Friday | Friday |
| Monday 18:00 | Thursday | 3: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday | Monday — the 17:00 rule applies only to shorter bookings |
| Friday 10:00 | Sunday | 2 | Friday — the scheduled pickup date |
| Friday 17:00 | Saturday | 1 | Saturday — the day after the pickup date |
| Thursday 16:59 | Thursday | 0 | Thursday |
| Thursday 17:00 | Thursday | 0 | Friday |

A booking of seven or more days always takes in a Saturday and is rated as a Saturday.
